definition: Sharp is a Shape Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having a fine point or thin edge.
normalization_note: Changed 'inhering in' to 'that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer'.

label: Silver Color
original_definition: A Color that resembles Grey with the added feature of having a metallic shine.
definition: Silver Color is a Color that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer resembling Grey with the added feature of having a metallic shine.
normalization_note: Capitalized existing class label Grey; added 'that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer'.

label: Size Quality
original_definition: A Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer's extension in one or more dimensions.
definition: Size Quality is a Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer's extension in one or more dimensions.
normalization_note: Changed 'A Quality' to 'Size Quality is a Quality that'.

label: Sloped
original_definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having a horizontal border which is not level.
definition: Sloped is a Shape Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having a horizontal border which is not level.
normalization_note: Changed 'A Shape Quality inhering in' to 'Sloped is a Shape Quality that inheres in'.

label: Spatial Orientation
original_definition: A Relational Quality that is the angle of Rotation of an Object relative to one or more Plane of Reference or Axis of Rotation.
definition: Spatial Orientation is a Relational Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer being the angle of rotation of an object relative to one or more plane of reference or axis of rotation.
normalization_note: Rephrased definition to use 'that inheres in a bearer in virtue of' and replaced 'its' / implicit relations with explicit phrasing.

label: Spherical
original_definition: A Three Dimensional Shape inhering in a bearer in virtue of all of its cross sections being round.
definition: Spherical is a Three Dimensional Shape that inheres in a bearer in virtue of all of the bearer's cross sections being round.
normalization_note: Changed 'inhering in' to 'that inheres in'; replaced 'its' with 'the bearer's'.

label: Split
original_definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having a linear opening, or having been divided into parts.
definition: Split is a Shape Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having a linear opening or having been divided into parts.
normalization_note: Changed 'inhering in' to 'that inheres in'; replaced 'the bearer' appropriately.

label: Square
original_definition: A Rectangular shape which has four equal length sides and four 90 degree angles.
definition: Square is a Rectangular that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having four equal length sides and four 90 degree angles.
normalization_note: Rephrased to follow the required start and standard in virtue formula.

label: Straight
original_definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer not having curves, bends, or angles along its borders.
definition: Straight is a Shape Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer not having curves, bends, or angles along the bearer's borders.
normalization_note: Changed 'inhering in' to 'that inheres in'; replaced 'its' with 'the bearer's'.

label: Strength
original_definition: A Realizable Entity that is realized when its bearer exerts or resists some power, influence, or force.
definition: Strength is a Realizable Entity that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the realizable entity being realized when the bearer exerts or resists some power, influence, or force.
normalization_note: Adjusted phrasing to match the required start and incorporated the bearer explicitly.

label: Surface Tension
original_definition: A Disposition that inheres in a liquid and is realized when the cohesive forces of the molecules in the bearer at the surface are greater than the adhesive forces of the molecules in the surrounding air.
definition: Surface Tension is a Disposition that inheres in a liquid bearer in virtue of the disposition being realized when the cohesive forces of the molecules in the bearer at the surface are greater than the adhesive forces of the molecules in the surrounding air.
normalization_note: Adjusted phrasing to use the required start and explicitly reference the bearer.

label: Temperature
original_definition: A Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of its thermal energy.
definition: Temperature is a Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer's thermal energy.
normalization_note: Replaced 'its' with 'the bearer's'.

label: Texture
original_definition: A Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the size, shape, and distribution of features on its surface, typically on a continuum from smooth to rough.
definition: Texture is a Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the size, shape, and distribution of features on the bearer's surface, typically on a continuum from smooth to rough.
normalization_note: Replaced 'its' with 'the bearer's'.

label: Thickness
original_definition: A Depth that inheres in a bearer in virtue of it extending inward through an object.
definition: Thickness is a Depth that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer extending inward through an object.
normalization_note: Changed 'inhering in' to 'that inheres in'; replaced 'it' with 'the bearer'.

label: Thin
original_definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having a width or depth which is significantly smaller in proportion to its length or height.
definition: Thin is a Shape Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having a width or depth which is significantly smaller in proportion to the bearer's length or height.
normalization_note: Changed 'inhering in' to 'that inheres in'; replaced 'its' with 'the bearer's'.

label: Three Dimensional Extent
original_definition: A Size Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer's extension in three dimensions.
definition: Three Dimensional Extent is a Size Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer's extension in three dimensions.
normalization_note: Kept original meaning and applied standard CCO structure.

label: Three Dimensional Shape
original_definition: A Shape Quality that inheres only in a three dimensional entity.
definition: Three Dimensional Shape is a Shape Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer being a three dimensional entity.
normalization_note: Rewrote the conditional restriction into the standard 'in virtue of' format.

label: Translucent
original_definition: An Opacity that inheres in a bearer in virtue of that bearer's capacity to transmit some but not all electromagnetic radiation of a given frequency through the bearer such that the bearer reflects, scatters, or absorbs some but not all electromagnetic radiation of that frequency.
definition: Translucent is an Opacity that inheres in a bearer in virtue of that bearer's capacity to transmit some but not all electromagnetic radiation of a given frequency through the bearer such that the bearer reflects, scatters, or absorbs some but not all electromagnetic radiation of that frequency.
normalization_note: Changed 'An Opacity that inheres' to the required start; retained all original conditions.

label: Transparent
original_definition: An Opacity that inheres in a bearer in virtue of that bearer's capacity to transmit all or nearly all electromagnetic radiation of a given frequency through the bearer such that the bearer reflects, scatters, or absorbs little or no electromagnetic radiation of that frequency.
definition: Transparent is an Opacity that inheres in a bearer in virtue of that bearer's capacity to transmit all or nearly all electromagnetic radiation of a given frequency through the bearer such that the bearer reflects, scatters, or absorbs little or no electromagnetic radiation of that frequency.
normalization_note: Changed 'An Opacity that inheres' to the required start; retained all original conditions.

label: Triangular
original_definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of it having exactly three angles and exactly three sides.
definition: Triangular is a Shape Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having exactly three angles and exactly three sides.
normalization_note: Changed 'inhering in' to 'that inheres in'; replaced 'it' with 'the bearer'.

label: Two Dimensional Extent
original_definition: A Size Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer's extension in two dimensions.
definition: Two Dimensional Extent is a Size Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer's extension in two dimensions.
normalization_note: Kept original meaning and applied standard CCO structure.

label: Vermilion
original_definition: A Color consisting of red and orange hue with a slight amount of gray.
definition: Vermilion is a Color that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer consisting of Red and Orange hue with a slight amount of Grey.
normalization_note: FLAG: Original definition used nominal phrase 'consisting of'. Capitalized existing class labels Red, Orange, and Grey, and added the bearer clause.

label: Violet
original_definition: A Color that is lower than Blue with a wavelength in the visible spectrum typically between 400 and 450 nanometers.
definition: Violet is a Color that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer reflecting or emitting light with a shorter wavelength than Blue, typically between 400 and 450 nanometers in the visible spectrum.
normalization_note: Replaced 'lower than' with explicit comparison 'with a shorter wavelength than'; capitalized Blue; added 'that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer reflecting or emitting light' to follow CCO style.

label: Vulnerability
original_definition: A Disrupting Disposition the realization of which would disrupt a process that the bearer of the Disrupting Disposition has an interest in.
definition: Vulnerability is a Disrupting Disposition that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the fact that the realization of the disposition would disrupt a process that the bearer has an interest in.
normalization_note: Added 'that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the fact that' to follow CCO style; replaced 'it'/'its' implicitly with the bearer.

label: Wavy
original_definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of it having a sinuous or rippled border.
definition: Wavy is a Shape Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having a sinuous or rippled border.
normalization_note: Changed 'inhering in' to 'that inheres in'; replaced pronoun 'it' with 'the bearer'.

label: Weight
original_definition: A Quality that inheres in some material entity with a mass in virtue of its location in some gravitational field.
definition: Weight is a Quality that inheres in a material entity with a Mass in virtue of the material entity having mass and its location in some gravitational field.
normalization_note: Capitalized Mass; expanded 'its' to 'the material entity's' or similar; structured with CCO phrasing while preserving original meaning.

label: Wetness
original_definition: A Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the degree to which the bearer is covered by a liquid, typically on a continuum of dry to wet.
definition: Wetness is a Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the degree to which the bearer is covered by a liquid, typically on a continuum of dry to wet.
normalization_note: Changed 'inheres in a bearer in virtue of' (kept original meaning structure); ensured single sentence.

label: White
original_definition: A Color of maximum brightness, the color of objects that reflect nearly all wavelengths of the visible light spectrum, thus considered achromatic.
definition: White is a Color that inheres in a bearer in virtue of having maximum Color Brightness and reflecting nearly all wavelengths of the visible light spectrum, thus being considered achromatic.
normalization_note: Added 'that inheres in a bearer in virtue of'; incorporated Color Brightness; rewrote the relative clause to maintain a single sentence following CCO style.

label: Wide
original_definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having a width or depth which is significantly larger in proportion to its length or height.
definition: Wide is a Shape Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having a Width or Depth that is significantly larger in proportion to the bearer's Length or Height.
normalization_note: Changed 'inhering in' to 'that inheres in'; capitalized Width, Depth, Length, and Height; replaced vague pronouns 'its' with 'the bearer's'.

label: Width
original_definition: A One Dimensional Extent that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer's extension in a horizontal direction.
definition: Width is a One Dimensional Extent that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer's extension in a horizontal direction.
normalization_note: Replaced 'inheres in a bearer in virtue of' to match CCO style; replaced 'the bearer's' for clarity.

label: Yaw Orientation
original_definition: A Spatial Orientation of an Object relative to its Yaw Axis.
definition: Yaw Orientation is a Spatial Orientation that inheres in a bearer that is an Object in virtue of the Object's orientation relative to the Object's Yaw Axis.
normalization_note: Added 'that inheres in a bearer that is an Object in virtue of' to conform to CCO property style; capitalized Object and Yaw Axis; replaced 'its' with 'the Object's'.

label: Yellow
original_definition: A Color that is between Orange and Green with a wavelength in the visible spectrum typically between 560 to 590 nanometers.
definition: Yellow is a Color that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer reflecting or emitting light that is between Orange and Green with a wavelength in the visible spectrum typically between 560 to 590 nanometers.
normalization_note: Capitalized Orange and Green; added 'that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer reflecting or emitting light' to follow CCO style.
